profile.headline: Lead Support Engineer at Radian Group Inc
profile.summary:
An Analyst/Programmer with nearly 30 years IT Industry experience including 20 years programming and production support experience in various Industries. In depth knowledge and experience in all aspects of the development life cycle from analysis and design to implementation. Has gained a solid foundation in various business applications. Has a proven record of producing deliverables on time. 
Recognized for success incorporating user needs into cost-effective and user-friendly solutions, known for scalability and durability.
Areas of expertise include:
Sybase SQL
Application / Production Support
Informatica
Qlikview
Perl
Mainframe (Natural Adabas)
Collateral Management System
Batch Processing
PowerShell
Fluent in French

positions.title: Lead Support Engineer
positions.description:
Provide real-time application support for Radian’s proprietary MI portal, responding to
production issues and user requests.
Analyze Splunk logs and alerts to identify errors, investigate root causes, and proactively
mitigate issues.
Address client issues and requests while coordinating timely resolution with internal
support teams.
Create and use Splunk dashboards to monitor events and transactions
Support EDI processing of MISMO files submissions, Remittance and Billing.

positions.title: Financial
positions.description:
As a consultant, was involved in daily support of Equity Settlement systems as well as developing new programs and reports as per business requests. 
In 2003 transferred to the DocPoint team and was involved in maintenance role for IED Collateral Management portion of application. Main responsibility was to ensure batch feeds ran correctly as well as user support and code maintenance/development for the application. Technologies used were C#, Perl, Sybase SQl, MainFrame Natural ADABAS.
Helped migrate Collateral Management into stand alone application (Corsica) and then integration into EGTS. Converted to full time employee then.
Currently part of the BRM CP Margining team, responsible for maintenance and support of EGTS application. Technologies used are Sybase SQL, Perl script, Informatica. Starting to use Java and DB2 presently.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: As a consultant, responsible for the analysis, design and development of the cost analysis system using NATURAL 2 programming language interfacing with ADABAS Database on a mainframe using MVS/VSE and COMPLETE.

positions.title: Senior Analyst/Programmer
positions.description:
responsible for new developments and maintenance of the financial aspects in the Bill of Materials department using NATURAL 2 programming language interfacing with ADABAS database. Worked with NATURAL 2 running on a Hitachi mainframe using MVS/XA and Complete. Was in charge of the Local Content (all parts manufactured locally) Database, Financial Analysis System, the Parts and the Accessories system. Also responsible for design, development and coding of new programs/reports and/or screens on the Main Frame (both capturing screens and display screens) to support these systems using NATURAL 2 language. 	

In May 1998, chosen to join the SAP implementation team and has attended the SAPSA ABAP ACADEMY. Involved in the conversion team to migrate in-house system from Natural to SAP.  Main function was to write extraction programs in Natural/Adabas on the legacy system and equivalent upload programs in ABAP for the data take on. Involved in all modules with the data take on programs. Also involved in devising new reports and modifying existing SAP R/3 reports using ABAP language to suit the users. Has been exposed to SAP Workflow and has developed user specific Layout Sets mainly for the MM module.

positions.title: an analyst/programmer
positions.description:
who originally joined as a computer operator, trained as a NATURAL 2 programmer interfacing with an ADABAS database, using MVS/VSE, Complete and TSO. 	

One of the main developments performed was to computerize the Shipping documentation. This involved extracting the data from the Main Frame via programs written in NATURAL 2, writing it to a flat file, downloading to the local server using TCP/IP protocol and then merging it with a predefined Word template to produce the different Shipping Documents (Shipping Order, Mate's Receipts and Bills of Lading).
